reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (branch_renamed seed 1 resolves to 'merge', which accepts ['merge']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'retrack', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'merge' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
set -e
git fetch --prune {upstream_remote}
branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)
git branch --set-upstream-to={upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} "$branch"
git merge {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} --no-edit
refused_program.intent: When upstream renames its default branch, prune the stale remote-tracking branch, retarget the current local branch to track the new upstream branch, and merge it into the local commits.
